name: week
title: Forwarding week
subtitle: Fictional demo data until you import your own shipments

sections.title: Breached or due now
sections.note: Rule findings with the rule cited. docs/compliance.md has the source for each.
sections.sql: select rule,reference,finding from compliance_findings where severity=1 order by rule,reference

sections.title: Arrivals in the next seven days
sections.sql: select reference,customer,mode,voyage,destination_port as port,eta,ata,cargo_reported_at is not null as cargo_reported,entry_number,containers from arrival_queue where days_to_arrival<=7 order by coalesce(ata,eta)

sections.title: Export cutoffs
sections.sql: select reference,customer,voyage,to_char(doc_cutoff_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as doc_cutoff,to_char(cargo_cutoff_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as cargo_cutoff,containers_without_vgm,dg_declaration_missing from cutoff_queue order by coalesce(doc_cutoff_at,cargo_cutoff_at)

sections.title: Containers against free time
sections.sql: select shipment,number,size,customer,free_until,days_left from container_free_time order by days_left

sections.title: Late milestones
sections.sql: select shipment,customer,operator,milestone,planned_on,days_late from milestone_exceptions order by days_late desc

name: money
title: Job profit
subtitle: What is unbilled, what leaked and what each job made

sections.title: Delivered and not invoiced
sections.sql: select reference,customer,operator,delivered_on,current_date-delivered_on as days,unbilled,profit from job_profit where delivered_on is not null and closed_on is null and (unbilled>0 or revenue=0) order by delivered_on

sections.title: Costs never charged on
sections.sql: select shipment,customer,code,description,supplier,cost from unrecovered_costs order by cost desc

sections.title: Every open and recent job
sections.sql: select reference,status,customer,revenue,cost,profit,margin_pct,unbilled,accrued from job_profit where closed_on is null or closed_on>=current_date-30 order by margin_pct nulls first

name: board
title: Shipment board
subtitle: Every open job by arrival or departure

sections.title: Open jobs
sections.sql: select reference,status,direction,mode,customer,route,carrier,etd,eta,days_to_eta,teu,operator from shipment_board order by coalesce(eta,etd)
